applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India ( Small Finance Banks - Classification, Valuation , and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Small finance banks must maintain an Investment Fluctuation Reserve of at least two per cent of the specified investment portfolio.
answer.action_quote: A bank shall create an Investment Fluctuation Reserve (IFR) out of the realised gains on sale of investments, subject to the availability of net profit, until the balance in IFR is at least two per cent of the AFS and FVTPL (including HFT) portfolio.

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India ( Small Finance Banks - Classification, Valuation, and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Directions, 2025
